Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0210');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from component_interdictions, valid_interdictions_lab vil
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and component_interdictions.inter_code =
 vil.inter_code
 and exists
 (select 'x'
 from components
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and component_interdictions.product_code=
 components.product_code
 and reject_reason_code is null
 and product_code != 'NONE'
/* ------------------ PR # 001000451---------------------------
 and (system_label_decision is null or
 (system_label_decision is not null and
 ((:GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'C' and
 system_label_decision in ('39','71'))
 or
 (:GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' and
 system_label_decision in
 (SELECT distinct abo_label ---Modified By HCLC
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE identifier_code = 'EM'
 OR abo_label = 'Mq'
 AND unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,SYSDATE+365)))
 )
 )
 )
-----------------------------------------------------------*/
 ) 
 and exists
 (select 'x'
 from valid_interdiction_class,
 user_interdiction_class
 where inter_code =
 vil.inter_code
 and valid_interdiction_class.inter_class =
 user_interdiction_class.inter_class
 and user_id = :banner.user_id);
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0199');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

LOV.Title: LIST OF VALID PRODUCT CODES FOR UNIT

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_2_PRODUCT_COD_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT UNIQUE component_interdictions.product_code, product_desc
 FROM component_interdictions, valid_products, valid_interdictions_lab VIL
 WHERE unit_id = :unit_id
 AND TRUNC(coll_date) = TRUNC(:coll_date)
 AND chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id
 AND component_interdictions.inter_code = VIL.inter_code
 AND SUBSTR (component_interdictions.product_code, 1, 5) = valid_products.product_code /* hclc */
 AND valid_products.unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme /*hclc*/
 AND NVL(VIL.system_inter_flag,'N') = 'Y' /*IM7290*/ 
 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN valid_products.eff_date AND NVL (valid_products.term_date, SYSDATE + 365)
 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN VIL.eff_date AND NVL (VIL.term_date,SYSDATE + 365)
 AND EXISTS (
 SELECT 'x'
 FROM components
 WHERE unit_id = :unit_id
 AND TRUNC (coll_date) = TRUNC (:coll_date)
 AND chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id
 AND component_interdictions.product_code = components.product_code
 AND reject_reason_code IS NULL
 AND product_code != 'NONE')
 AND EXISTS (
 SELECT 'x'
 FROM valid_interdiction_class vic, user_interdiction_class uic
 WHERE vic.inter_code = VIL.inter_code
 AND vic.inter_class = uic.inter_class
 AND uic.user_id = :banner.user_id
 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN vic.eff_date AND NVL (vic.term_date, SYSDATE)
 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN uic.eff_date AND NVL (uic.term_date, SYSDATE + 1))
 ORDER BY component_interdictions.product_code
